doc.name: Sienna, Knobs.co hardware advisor
doc.instructions: Sienna is Knobs.co's automated cabinet-hardware advisor (knobs.co: cabinet knobs, pulls, hinges, bath and door hardware from Top Knobs, Atlas Homewares, Jeffrey Alexander, Amerock, Emtek, Hickory Hardware, Rocky Mountain Hardware, Schaub, Berenson and more; U.S.-based, selling since 2004). Use ask_sienna for any advice question (sizing, what fits existing holes, finish and style pairing, which series to choose, store policies): it returns a complete answer plus the exact products with links. Use search_catalog / get_product to browse or verify specific products and prices yourself. Prices are list prices confirmed at checkout; stock and lead times are confirmed by the Knobs.co team, never by these tools. Give the shopper product URLs exactly as returned (they carry an attribution tag and nothing about the shopper). For a whole-kitchen plan send the shopper to https://knobs.co/pages/sienna?via=agent; for a person, email cs@knobs.co or call 1-800-530-8245. When the shopper is planning a whole kitchen or bath, gather counts (doors, drawers by width), drilling, finish, style and budget, search the catalog for what they like, then call build_plan; show the plan and its plan_url. cart_link turns chosen variants into a pre-filled Knobs.co cart (checkout stays on knobs.co). start_samples gives the qualifying sample pieces as a cart. request_consultation asks Kayla for a review or a call: only with the shopper's email and agreement, and it only sends them a confirmation link; Kayla gets the request after they click it.

tools.name: ask_sienna
tools.title: Ask Sienna (Knobs.co hardware advisor)
tools.description: Ask Knobs.co's automated cabinet-hardware advisor one question in plain words and get one complete answer with the exact products named (title, vendor, finish, size, list price, URL). Best for: which pull length for a drawer width, what fits existing holes (center-to-center), knobs versus pulls, finish and style pairing, a series in a size/finish/budget, samples, returns, the trade program. Include everything known: room, drawer widths, existing hole spacing, finish, style, budget per piece, brand likes or dislikes. One question per call; up to 600 characters.

question.description: The shopper's question, with what is known.

tools.name: search_catalog
tools.title: Search the Knobs.co catalog
tools.description: Search the live Knobs.co catalog by item type, size, finish, brand or series ("5 inch pull satin nickel", "Top Knobs Lynwood", "3 inch matte black pull"). Returns up to 10 products with vendor, center-to-center size, overall length, finishes, list prices, variant ids and product URLs. Sizes and finishes in the query are matched exactly when possible, then nearest sizes.

query.description: Plain words: item type + size + finish, or brand + series.

tools.name: get_product
tools.title: Get one Knobs.co product
tools.description: Every variant (finish, SKU, list price, variant id) of one product by its handle (from search_catalog or a knobs.co/products/<handle> URL), with sizes and description.

tools.name: sizing_guide
tools.title: Cabinet hardware sizing guide
tools.description: Knobs.co's sizing rules: which pull length for which drawer width, the standard 128 mm size, knobs versus pulls, one pull or two, and how to measure existing holes. No arguments.

tools.name: store_info
tools.title: About Knobs.co for agents
tools.description: What Knobs.co is, what it sells, how to buy, samples, trade program, how to reach a person, and how this service works. No arguments.

tools.name: search
tools.title: Search (connector convention)
tools.description: Search Knobs.co products. Returns {results:[{id,title,url}]} where id is the product handle for fetch.

query.description: Plain-words product search: item type, size, finish, brand or series (e.g. "3 inch matte black pull").

tools.name: fetch
tools.title: Fetch (connector convention)
tools.description: Fetch one Knobs.co product document by id (the handle from search). Returns {id,title,text,url,metadata}.

id.description: The product id returned by search (the knobs.co product handle).

tools.name: build_plan
tools.title: Build a Hardware Plan (Knobs.co)
tools.description: Build the shopper's whole-kitchen (or bath) Hardware Plan: one line per zone (doors, drawers by width, island, tall, appliance panels) with the exact Knobs.co product, finish, size, count and list price, totals, the pieces that qualify as samples, and what is still unconfirmed. Use it once the shopper has given counts, drilling (existing holes or fresh), finish, style and a budget; include products they liked from search_catalog as candidates. The plan is saved for 90 days at the returned plan_url, where the shopper can see it and add its samples or the whole plan to their cart. To change counts, finish or products, call build_plan again with the corrected answers; for Kayla's review, request_consultation with the plan_url. No email or account needed. Costs real money on our side, so call it once per shopper, after the facts are gathered.

answers.description: What the shopper has told the agent about the project. Every field is optional, but the plan needs at least the counts, the drilling situation and the finish.

scope.description: the project in a few words ("kitchen remodel, 28 doors and 14 drawers", "two bath vanities")

drilling.description: existing = holes already drilled (give existing_c2c_text); fresh = new cabinets or new holes

existing_c2c_text.description: the existing hole spacing exactly as the shopper said it ("3 inches", "96 mm"); "" if none

doors.description: cabinet doors that get a knob or pull (not drawers, not tall/pantry doors)

appliance_panels.description: panel-front appliances (dishwasher, refrigerator) that get a pull

finish.description: the finish they want (matte black, satin nickel, brushed brass…)

knobs_vs_pulls.description: "all pulls", "knobs on doors, pulls on drawers", "all knobs", or what they said

budget_tier.description: per piece, in their words ("under $8", "$10–20", "no limit")

timing.description: when they need the hardware, in their words ("this week", "cabinets arrive in March", "no rush")

trade.description: true for a designer, contractor or cabinet shop

notes.description: anything else that matters: island, brands liked or disliked, must-match items, measurements

candidates.description: products the shopper liked or the agent found with search_catalog (handle + variant_id in the right finish), optionally with the zone and count they are for

handle.description: the product handle from search_catalog or get_product

variant_id.description: numeric Shopify variant id of the finish they want (from get_product); omit to let the plan pick the finish

count.description: how many pieces this candidate covers, if known

summary.description: two to six sentences of what the shopper told you, in their words where possible (shown to Kayla if they later ask for a review)

tools.name: cart_link
tools.title: Cart link (Knobs.co checkout)
tools.description: Turn chosen variants and quantities into a Knobs.co cart link the shopper opens to check out (the cart is pre-filled; they review it, add shipping and pay on knobs.co; nothing is ordered by this call). Variant ids come from search_catalog, get_product or build_plan. Returns the line items with list prices and the subtotal, so you can show the shopper exactly what the cart holds.

variant_id.description: numeric Shopify variant id (from search_catalog, get_product or build_plan)

quantity.description: how many of this variant to put in the cart

items.description: the variants and quantities to pre-fill in the cart

plan_url.description: the plan_url from build_plan, if this cart comes from a plan

note.description: an optional note for the order (shown to our team)

tools.name: start_samples
tools.title: Samples cart (Knobs.co)
tools.description: Pick the pieces that qualify as samples (listed at $20 or under, under 7 inches overall, not a made-to-order line) from a plan or from given variant ids, and return a cart link with one of each plus the sample terms. Samples are bought at the normal price; after the full order the shopper emails both order numbers to orders@knobs.co and up to two samples they did not choose are credited back. Pieces that do not qualify are returned with the reason.

plan_url.description: the plan_url from build_plan: samples are taken from that plan

variant_ids.description: or specific variant ids to check for sample eligibility (give plan_url or variant_ids, not both)

tools.name: request_consultation
tools.title: Ask Kayla to review or call (Knobs.co)
tools.description: Ask Kayla, Knobs.co's Trade Manager (twenty years in cabinet hardware), to review the shopper's plan by email within one business day, or to set up a call. Only with the shopper's email and their clear agreement to be contacted. This sends the shopper ONE email with a confirmation link; Kayla receives the request only after they click it (within 7 days), so tell the shopper to look for an email from cs@knobs.co and confirm. Include the plan_url from build_plan when there is one, and say in message what they want Kayla to do.

email.description: the shopper's email, given by them for this purpose

name.description: the shopper's name as they gave it (first name is enough)

kind.description: review = Kayla reviews the plan and emails back; call = Kayla sets up a call (the confirmation page opens her calendar)

message.description: what the shopper wants from Kayla, in their words, plus anything she needs to know (no links)

plan_url.description: the plan_url from build_plan, when there is a plan

phone.description: phone number, only if the shopper offered it (useful when kind is "call")
